scope: Independent visual review of only the requested country-picker and expanded-note captures; source read with git show at exact tested commit.

observations: Target countries title, close action, JP search value and full search label are visible.
JP and the Arabic Japan label appear with a checked selection; the selection count and Clear selection text are readable.
The complete Use selected countries action is visible above the gesture bar after IME dismissal.
country_picker.source_evidence: Capture occurs after the IME Done action and JP selection, while the test asserts model.targetCountries is still empty. Subsequent preserved assertions check Apply commits JP, closing a FR draft keeps JP, and saving the profile keeps the selected country without service requests.
limits: This screenshot shows the picker after IME dismissal; it does not alone establish keyboard-open layout.
A static image does not alone prove selection persistence; the source assertions and separately recorded passing ordinary suite provide that evidence.

observations: All six synthetic note lines are fully visible, including Last private line.
Show less, the saved state and version timestamp are visible without ellipsis.
expanded_note.source_evidence: The test renders RecordVersionCard at fontScale2.0, expands it, and preserves assertions for unrestricted maxLines, no visual overflow, at least six lines, final character coverage, no final-line ellipsis, and final line within measured height.
limits: This is an isolated card in a scroll Column, not a full application navigation screen.
Production system-bar insets and every locale/device configuration cannot be established from this component capture.
